title: Daily Dose #353: Light for the Next Step
body:
**“Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.”**

Most of us would prefer a floodlight showing the next ten years. God often gives a lamp for the next step.

The Bible does not answer every question we may ask, but it clearly reveals who God is, what He has done through Jesus and how His people are called to live. It exposes what is wrong, gives wisdom for decisions and keeps us from treating our feelings as the final authority.

Sometimes we say we are waiting for direction when God has already made the next act of obedience clear. We want to know the future, while ignoring the apology, forgiveness, honesty or change required today.

Open Scripture before opening another stream of opinions. Read the passage in context. Ask what it shows about God, what it reveals about the human heart and what response it calls for. If something remains unclear, seek wise help—but do not delay what is clear.

God’s Word may not reveal the whole road at once. It gives enough light to walk faithfully now.
